editorial:
Imagine starting at a fancy new school where you just want to study and keep your scholarship, but instead, you get targeted by two weird twins. That is exactly what happens to Appel. You will quickly see how his quiet life gets flipped upside down when Glista and Glyde show up. These pink-haired siblings seem cute and friendly at first, but they have a creepy way of sticking to him like glue. The whole vibe feels like a colorful dream that slowly turns into a weird nightmare, making you wonder if these two are actually human or something much stranger.

The animation is bright and poppy, which makes the creepy moments feel even more surprising. You will love how the pacing keeps you guessing, though some of the slow parts in the middle might feel a bit long. If you enjoy stories where things are not what they seem, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that Glista and Glyde are not students at all, but parasitic creatures. They were using Appel to feed on his energy and hard work to survive. Just when Appel thinks he has escaped, the twins reveal they have already replaced his friends. The movie ends with Appel trapped in his own school, realizing he was the prey all along while the twins smile at the camera.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird comedies and psychological twists.
